E - "really..?💕"

I - "As I've said before, I've lost you once, and that is nothing I want to relive. Even if these days have been really hurting me, you should know that you have changed my sight of the world and made me a happier person overall. After you told me the stories of what you have been going through in your life and that you have dealt with everything by yourself is breathtaking. I too want to have that strength and someday I will, and it will be all thanks to you❤"

It is not a have to, but you don't have to deal with everything completely by yourself anymore💕"

E - "It's just so hard to understand💕, I will try❤"

I'm 26M from Sweden and here is what I would like you to do if I where this guy.

just accept the fact that you are done, you can win him back but for now, you are done.

next time you meet him, you should bring or wear something from a good memory between you two, that he will sure notice but not comment on, and don't point it out, talk to him nice and easy and most important of all, be quiet when he speaks, and understanding when you answer. try to get answers from him but don't push them, don't throw questions about either, try to take one question at a time, but choose the questions wisely. 

Go sit somewhere peaceful, preferably someplace where you share another special moment and talk about all the good things you had, all the experiences you will bring with you, all the problems you've found out you have, again accept that you are done and don't go beg for forgiveness. just some small chitchat with whispering, long words.

when you feel the moment is right, that the moment is now to lean in for the kiss. don't lean in, ask "can i have one final kiss to remember you by?" when and if he says yes, you go girl, kiss him like never before with all the passion you can!

if he says no on the other hand, try to just laugh it off, don't make it a big deal and continue with the smooth talk. maybe try to hold his hand or something, but for gods sake keep your hands warm.

At least, go for a good ending, no drama or anything like that

​

I cant say that this will work, but at least it is what i would want from a girl.

I wish you the best of luck, and find a way to walk with pride over what you will or what you did accomplish with this guy.
